chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Yunus ibn 'Ammar and Yunus ibn Yaqoub, altogether, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
It is not permissible for the woman that her slave should look at anything from her body except for her hair, without deliberate intention for that.
And in another report, (he said): There is no problem if he looks at her hair when he is trustworthy (a believer).
ai.seo_question: What parts of a female mistress's body is her male slave permitted to look at according to Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Al-Kafi* delineates the specific boundaries of visual modesty within the master-servant dynamic, restricting the male slave's gaze to the mistress's hair while excluding other body parts unless the gaze is unintentional. The secondary narration introduces the condition of *amanah* (trustworthiness), suggesting that a slave's general reliability may permit a more relaxed standard of visual interaction, reflecting the practical social realities of early Islamic households. This ruling highlights the nuanced Shia jurisprudence on *awrah* (modesty) in non-marital, hierarchical relationships.

en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Yunus Bin Ammar and Yunus Bin Yaqoub, altogether, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘It is not Permissible for the woman that her slave should see anything from her body except for her hair, without deliberation to that’.
And in another report, ‘(He<sup>asws</sup> said): ‘There is no problem if he looks at her hair when he was a Believer’.
en.sarwar: 4. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ibn Mahbub from Yunus ibn ‘Ammar and Yunus ibn Ya’qub all of them have said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
It is not lawful for a slave to look at any part of the body of his mistress except her hairs unintentionally.’”
In another Hadith it is said that it is not unlawful to look at her hairs if it is safe (from sinful feelings).
